name: Uncovering the Past
summary: Prospector Whelgar needs the Goaz Stone's four missing pieces from his overrun dig in the Wetlands. Its inscriptions await translation.

sections.title: The Broken Stone
sections.body: Before raptors overran the dig in the Wetlands, Prospector Whelgar unearthed the Goaz Stone. His first attempts to read its ancient script found broken references to a divine plan and a doomed prophecy. Four pieces had broken away, leaving passages scattered across the dig.

sections.title: Braving the Dig Site
sections.body: To restore the stone, you search the raptor guarded excavation for four fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru. The pieces lie among loose soil and half excavated relics, watched by aggressive Razormaws and Scytheclaws. Reaching them means facing the marsh's fiercest predators.

sections.title: Chained Beneath the Land
sections.body: The reassembled Goaz Stone bears the language of the Titans. As Whelgar translates its glyphs, he reads a chilling phrase: 'Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land.' The tablet speaks of struggles from the world's dawn and evils buried beneath Azeroth.

faq.answer: The Goaz Stone is an ancient Titan relic Prospector Whelgar found at his Wetlands excavation. Its cryptic inscriptions speak of a divine plan and ancient beings bound deep underground.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Uncovering the Past?
aliases: where to get uncovering the past
faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar offers it from a vantage point overlooking Whelgar's Excavation Site, east of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Feral raptors drove him from his dig.

faq.q: What fragments are needed to complete the tablet?
faq.answer: The four fragments are Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru. They are scattered among loose soil mounds and ancient urns across the raptor overrun quarry floor.

faq.q: Why can't Prospector Whelgar recover the fragments himself?
aliases: why doesn't whelgar get the stones
faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar is an elderly dwarven scholar. When vicious raptors invaded and took over the quarry, he had to retreat and could not fight through their packs alone.

faq.q: What do the translated Titan glyphs reveal?
aliases: what does the goaz stone say
old gods chained beneath the land
faq.answer: When the four pieces are joined, Whelgar translates the Titan script as 'Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land.' The words hint at ancient cosmic beings imprisoned during Azeroth's shaping.

faq.q: Does this quest tie into any other nearby expeditions?
faq.answer: Yes. Ormer Ironbraid's Ormer's Revenge sends adventurers to thin the raptors in the same excavation quarry.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Explorers' League prizes every relic for what it can reveal about dwarven origins. The Titan inscriptions on the Goaz Stone touch that ancient heritage.
As an Alliance member, you support League excavations across the Wetlands. They strengthen the Alliance's presence and preserve valuable knowledge from wild or hostile hands.
